title: Unweighted Hardy Inequalities on the Heisenberg Group and in Step-Two Carnot Groups
summary: We establish unweighted Hardy-type inequalities on step-two Carnot groups with one-dimensional vertical layer, with explicit lower bounds for the optimal Hardy constant. The approach is based on a quantitative integration-by-parts mechanism that replaces the non-horizontal Euler vector field by a suitably constructed horizontal vector field with controlled norm.
